reason: The free app already gives me 3 typed questions a day, which is more than I'd ever use, and typing with greasy fingers is exactly what I hate, so why pay 99 baht for more of it? I already know how to make kaprao and khai jiao, and if I get stuck I just LINE my mum.
objection: What they're selling is unlimited typing, the part I don't want to do with messy hands, and 99 baht a month is almost two plates of street food for me when I only cook when I have time.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to ask the chef out loud by voice instead of typing, and even then not at 99 baht a month.
